**Remote Work Pros:**
- **Flexibility** — control your schedule, work when you're most productive
- **No commute** — save time, money, and stress
- **Location freedom** — live where you want, travel more easily
- **Focused work** — fewer office interruptions, deeper concentration
- **Cost savings** — less on work clothes, lunches out, gas/transit

**Remote Work Cons:**
- **Isolation** — can get lonely without daily human contact
- **Blurred boundaries** — harder to "leave" work at the end of the day
- **Career visibility** — out of sight can mean out of mind for promotions
- **Collaboration friction** — some things are just slower over video calls
- **Home distractions** — pets, kids, household stuff competing for attention

The sweet spot for most people seems to be hybrid — a couple days in-office, a couple at home.
